text:
Rena Gupta: Heads up Candidate: Jordan Park (SWE, backend). Final loop scheduled for Thu 11/16 09:30-11:00 PT onsite. Jordan's coming from out of state. Can we confirm travel + on-site logistics?
Sam Brooks: I can handle travel approvals. Does the role have a travel cap?
Rena Gupta: Hiring matrix says up to $500 for cross-country candidates. Need hotel for 1 night and ground transport.
RecruiterBot: Note: candidate flagged as "needs wheelchair access" in profile. Hotel + pickup recommended.
Maya Li: Got it. I'll arrange a ground pickup and ensure the meeting room is wheelchair accessible. Also will order lunch (GLUTEN-FREE noted).
Tomas Alvarez: I'll reserve conference room Echo (ground floor) and test the room AV at 9:00am. Any assistive tech needed?
Rena Gupta: Jordan asked if interview materials can be provided in plain text ahead of time (no scanned images). Also prefers a longer break between interviews. Could we spread sessions a bit?
Sam Brooks: We can shift the middle session 10:00-10:40 -> 10:10-10:50 to give 20 min breaks. That's within interviewer availability.
Maya Li: I'll send the candidate a plain-text packet and confirm dietary/additional needs. Also will include directions with accessible entrance instructions and accessible restroom location.
RecruiterBot: Calendar: created provisional invite. Travel budget reserved: $480. Expense code: HR-INT-26. Hotel: 1 night at partner hotel (confirmed). Pickup: 8:00am from airport to office.
Tomas Alvarez: AV test scheduled. Will add a wired keyboard and extra mouse in case of mobility/precision needs. I'll also add a second display for screen magnification if needed.
Office Ops: Parking permit for one visitor added (Lot A). Accessibility escort available at reception. Driver contact: +1-415-555-0198.
Rena Gupta: Please include the driver's phone and a backup transit plan if flight is delayed. Also include a phone number for the on-site People Ops lead.
Maya Li: I'll add two contact numbers in the candidate packet and text the driver ETA once Jordan's flight lands.
Sam Brooks: Approved: reimbursement for reasonable accessible transport up to $200 if we need a specialized service. Add note to expense docs.
RecruiterBot: Candidate packet (plain-text) emailed to Jordan. Calendar invites updated with new timings and room location. Accessibility accommodations added to candidate profile.
Rena Gupta: Thank you. Final ask: can someone pick up a printed copy of the interview rubrics in large-font? Jordan said large-print is helpful.
Tomas Alvarez: I'll print large-font rubrics and leave them at reception under Jordan Park. Will confirm here when done.
Maya Li: Lunch set to vegetarian + gluten-free. Reception will have escort sign. I've also added a backup Zoom link to the invite in case Jordan prefers remote at last minute.
Tomas Alvarez: AV check complete at 9:05am PT. Wired keyboard and second monitor confirmed.
RecruiterBot: Status: All logistics confirmed. Reminder: please log receipts to HR-INT-26 within 14 days.
Rena Gupta: Great team, thanks everyone. If flight changes, post here and we'll adjust.
Maya Li: Noted. Will update if anything changes. :sparkles:
